text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
An utterly shocking blitzkrieg! The one 
who crushed countless famed sprinters is—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
King Halo! That very King Halo takes 1st 
place!
(WOOOOOOOOOOO---!!)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, I wonder if everyone is 
surprised? Or maybe they're just trembling 
too much with joy.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Yet, these results proved only one thing.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I... did have talent after all...! Right, 
Trainer...?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you did well too... nurturing my 
talent and making it shine.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"That is precisely why... all the 
attention today is focused entirely on 
us."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: For "King and her Trainer," that is...!

Upon returning to the waiting room with 
King Halo...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: King-san, King-san, King-saaaan!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Kawakami-san, you...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
King-san, you were simply wonderful after 
all! In the final stretch, you dashed like 
the wind, just like in episode 32 of 
"Prifight"...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Kuh... I will definitely win the 
Takamatsunomiya Kinen someday! I swear it!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Fufu, you really are such a klutz.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You might look up to me, but you don't 
need to chase after my shadow.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Become first-rate at whatever it is you 
want to be.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...K-Kaka...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: That was simply marvelous~~!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Now then... shall we decide on our next 
goal?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: As for the current situation—hmmm.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Spring) is shaping up to be 
a thrilling showdown between Special Week 
and Seiun Sky.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Grass-san has announced she'll be running 
in the Takarazuka Kinen. What's more, El 
Condor Pasa-san, who had her sights set 
overseas, might run too."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Or so they say.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
It looks like their respective rivalries 
have been firmly established.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Well, it's certainly a classic trope to 
build excitement. But looking at it from 
another angle..."
choice_data_list: And what would the opposite be?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"It means I can shine as the one and only 
leading star, without any rivals."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Besides, the way things are looking now, 
the hype around mile races this summer 
seems lacking too.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
What do you think? Shall King lend you her 
legs for this year's Yasuda Kinen?

"The Yasuda Kinen is a 1600m turf mile 
race. While it's longer than today's 
Takamatsunomiya Kinen—"
choice_data_list: What do you want to do?
What do you want to do?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Oh, isn't it obvious?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I shall claim the throne of Mile King as 
well. After all, it is a place befitting 
the brilliance of a King.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"After all, we're not the kind of people 
to let things end here, right?"

—And so, we set our sights on our next 
goal: the Yasuda Kinen.
